title: A textbook places answering a request to wave or blow a kiss around 9 to 12 months
summary: OpenStax Psychology says infants respond to requests such as wave bye-bye or blow a kiss around 9 to 12 months.
body: In the lifespan chapter, OpenStax gives cognitive examples that include shaking the head for no around 6 to 9 months, and responding to verbal requests to wave bye-bye or blow a kiss around 9 to 12 months. The line is about answering the request, inside a range, in a textbook summary. It is not the CDC statement that most children produce a wave by the first birthday, and it is not a 75 percent cutoff. The book is a secondary text. Other lists use other ages.
